ordinance: City Planning Code, Part II, Chapter II, Section 105, with amendments to and including February 2, 1975 (date on sheet 2)
map_title: Zoning Map of the City and County of San Francisco, Sheets 1-13, with special use (1SU, 2SU), height and bulk (1H-13H) and special sign district sheets
structure: Eighteen districts: dwelling (R-1-D to R-5, with R-4-C and R-5-C), commercial (C-1, C-2, four downtown C-3 subdistricts, C-M), industrial (M-1, M-2) and Public (P).
hierarchy: Cumulative within the dwelling family: each R district permits the uses of the one before it. C-M and both M districts exclude one- and two-family dwellings; M districts exclude all housing.
boundary_rule: Districts are drawn on the 13 map sheets as heavy boundary lines with a printed district label.

zones.name: One-Family Detached Dwelling District
conditional_uses: Private school for profit, nursery school, institution of higher learning
Non-commercial open recreation, community club house, community garage
Utility installation, planned unit development, greenhouse or nursery (no retail sales)
transitional_uses: One-family row house and two-family dwelling on lots adjacent to or facing a C or M district
form_rules: Lot size 4,000 sq ft (except lots of record); one dwelling unit per lot
Coverage: 55% interior lot, 60% corner lot
Side yards together at least 10 ft, none under 5 ft; rear yard 25 ft (corner lot 20 ft)
Height: dwellings 35 ft (30-40 ft on sloping lots); institutions 75 ft
Parking: one space per dwelling unit
zones.summary: Detached single-family houses on 4,000 sq ft lots with side yards; 35 ft height limit.

zones.name: One-Family Dwelling District
conditional_uses: Same as R-1-D, plus parking lot and access driveway to a C or M district
transitional_uses: Two-family dwelling, professional office for one person, private non-commercial club or lodge, on lots adjacent to or facing a C or M district
form_rules: Lot size 2,640 sq ft in new subdivisions, 2,500 sq ft otherwise; one unit per lot or per 3,000 sq ft
Coverage: 60% interior, 75% corner
No side yard required (3 ft minimum if provided); rear yard 25 ft (corner 20 ft)
Height: dwellings 35 ft (30-40 ft on sloping lots)
Parking: one space per dwelling unit
zones.summary: Single-family houses, including row houses, on standard 25-foot lots; 35 ft height limit.

zones.name: Two-Family Dwelling District
permitted_uses: Home for the aged (up to six persons)
conditional_uses: Same as R-1, plus hospital, sanitarium, rest home (over 6 patients), philanthropic institution
transitional_uses: Multiple dwelling, private club or lodge, boarding house, professional office for one person, fraternity, advertising sign, on lots adjacent to or facing a C or M district
form_rules: Lot size 2,640 / 2,500 sq ft; one two-family dwelling per lot or 1,500 sq ft per unit
Coverage: 65% interior, 75% corner
No side yard required; rear yard 25 ft (corner 15 ft)
Height: dwellings 40 ft (30-40 ft on sloping lots)
Parking: one space per dwelling unit
zones.summary: Duplexes and single-family houses; 1,500 sq ft of lot per unit; 40 ft height limit.

zones.name: Low-Density Multiple Dwelling District
permitted_uses: Multiple-family dwelling of not more than 3 stories
conditional_uses: Same as R-2, plus institutions for contagious disease or addiction treatment on a block or lot of 3+ acres, hotel, private club or lodge
transitional_uses: All R-4 principal uses and R-2 transitional uses, on lots adjacent to or facing a C or M district
form_rules: Lot size 2,640 / 2,500 sq ft; 400 sq ft of lot per dwelling unit
Coverage: 70% interior, 75% corner
No side yard required; rear yard 25 ft (corner 15 ft)
Height: dwellings 40 ft
Parking: one per unit; may be within 600 ft of the lot for multiple dwellings
zones.summary: Walk-up apartments up to three stories; 400 sq ft of lot per unit; 40 ft height limit.

zones.name: R-3.5 Dwelling District (between R-3 and R-4)
Medium-Density Multiple Dwelling District
conditional_uses: Same as R-3, plus professional offices under specific regulations
transitional_uses: Professional office building, restaurant, personal service shop, newsstand, storage garage and some other uses, on lots adjacent to or facing a C or M district
form_rules: Lot size 2,640 / 2,500 sq ft; 200 sq ft of lot per dwelling unit
Coverage: 75% interior, 80% corner
Rear yard 15 ft (1-3 stories) or 25 ft (4+ stories)
Floor area ratio 4.8 (corner lots +25% for calculation); no fixed height limit
Parking: one per unit; one per 8 hotel bedrooms over 20 rooms
zones.summary: Apartment buildings of any height up to a 4.8 floor area ratio; 200 sq ft of lot per unit.

zones.name: High-Density Multiple Dwelling District
transitional_uses: As for R-4; multiple dwelling as regulated in R-5 if adjacent to a C-3 district
form_rules: Lot size 2,640 / 2,500 sq ft; 125 sq ft of lot per dwelling unit (one-room-and-kitchen apartment counts as 3/4 unit)
Coverage: 75% interior, 90% corner
Rear yard 10 ft (1-3 stories) or 20 ft (4+ stories)
Floor area ratio 10.0; no fixed height limit
Parking: one per unit
zones.summary: High-rise apartments and hotels up to a 10.0 floor area ratio; 125 sq ft of lot per unit.

zones.name: Neighborhood Shopping District
permitted_uses: Dwellings as in the nearest R district (never fewer units than R-3 allows)
conditional_uses: Planned unit development, aircraft landing field, wireless transmission tower, railroad, institutions for contagious disease or addiction treatment
form_rules: No coverage limit except floors used for residence
Yards only for residential floors, as in the nearest R district
Floor area ratio 3.6; dwellings no taller than 40 ft next to R-1-D, R-1, R-2 or R-3
Parking: one per dwelling unit; varies by use above 5,000 sq ft; loading spaces for some uses
zones.summary: Neighborhood stores, services and offices with apartments above; 3.6 floor area ratio.

zones.name: Community Business District
conditional_uses: Same as C-1, plus animal hospital, mortuary, parcel delivery, minor auto repair (enclosed), auto sales lot, household goods storage
form_rules: No coverage limit except floors used for residence
Floor area ratio 3.6; dwellings no taller than 40 ft next to R-1-D, R-1, R-2 or R-3
Parking: as C-1; theatres one space per 8 seats; mortuaries five spaces
zones.summary: Larger shopping streets and community business; 3.6 floor area ratio.

zones.name: Downtown Support District
form_rules: FAR 7:1 (unverified)
zones.summary: Downtown service and support area south of Market.

zones.name: Downtown General Commercial District
form_rules: FAR 10:1 (unverified)

zones.name: Downtown Retail District
form_rules: FAR 10:1 (unverified)

zones.name: Downtown Office District
form_rules: FAR 14:1 (unverified)

zones.name: Heavy Commercial District
conditional_uses: Same as C-2, plus experimental laboratory and enclosed dairy distribution plant
form_rules: Floor area ratio 9.0
Parking varies by use; loading spaces required
zones.summary: Wholesale, storage and service commerce at the edge of downtown; 9.0 floor area ratio; no houses.

zones.name: Light Industrial District
excluded_uses: Dwelling, hotel, motel or boarding house
conditional_uses: Planned unit development, truck terminal at least 200 ft from any R district, institutions for contagious disease or addiction treatment
form_rules: No coverage or yard requirements
Floor area ratio 5.0
Parking: about one space per 1,500 sq ft of floor area over 7,500 sq ft; loading required
zones.summary: Light manufacturing and industry; no housing; 5.0 floor area ratio.

zones.name: Heavy Industrial District
excluded_uses: Dwelling, hotel, motel, boarding house, school or institution for human habitation
conditional_uses: Same as M-1, plus smelter, garbage incineration, corrosive acid or alkali, cement, gypsum, explosives, petroleum refining, abattoir
form_rules: No coverage or yard requirements
Floor area ratio 5.0
Parking: one space per 2,000 sq ft of floor area over 10,000 sq ft for M-2 uses; loading required
zones.summary: Heavy industry, food processing, and by approval the noxious trades; no housing; 5.0 floor area ratio.

zones.name: Public District
zones.summary: Land in public use. New after 1960.

form_fields.min_lot_sqft: Minimum lot area for new lots (sq ft)
form_fields.lot_sqft_per_unit: Lot area required per dwelling unit (sq ft); in C districts it follows the nearest R district
form_fields.max_units_per_lot: Dwelling units allowed per lot (0 = no housing)
form_fields.height_limit_ft: Height limit for dwellings (ft); null where FAR governs
